en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail Bin Marrar, from Yunus, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Musa Bin Bakr, from Zurara Bin Ayn, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The dower is everything which the people are agreed upon, little or more, be it regarding a temporary or permanent marriage.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ‘Isma’il ibn Marrar from Yunus al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Musa ibn Bakr from Zurarah ibn ‘A‘yan who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The amount of mahr (dower) is that upon which people agree and it can be little or a great deal, in an advantageous marriage or non-advantageous marriage.’”
